status: shipped; S7/S13 partial, 430x932 and reduced-motion unverified
objective: Make the Early Access hero map read as a real reference map, and rebuild the interactive product demo on a shared fixture layer so every claim carries a state, a source and a recheck time.
architectureContracts: lib/map-geometry.ts is generated only by scripts/build-map.mjs from Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 and admin-1 GeoJSON; never hand-edit it.
MAP_VIEWBOX.bounds is derived from the admin-0 selection alone so MAP_CITIES projection stays stable when province geometry is regenerated.
LANDMARK_ART keys must stay 1:1 with MAP_CITIES ids; a missing key renders an empty symbol.
Landmark glyphs are authored on a 32x32 grid, stroke-only, coloured through currentColor; stroke width is set per usage, not in the symbol.
The hero map plate never pans, rolls or zooms on its own; only the pointer-driven lens transforms, and only for fine pointers.
Product Demo copy stays centralized and bilingual in lib/copy.ts.
The frozen waitlist API, validation, rate limit and the direct JotForm CTA were not touched.
lib/demo is the single source of truth for the product demo. Superseded fixtures were removed from lib/copy.ts; do not reintroduce demo content there.
Every demo claim renders through StateBadge / ConfidenceTag / EvidenceChip. A number without a source and a recheck time is a bug.
No Canvas change may apply without passing through the diff. There is no silent-update path.
Hard constraints (peanut allergy, step-free access) are never overridden automatically anywhere in the demo.
Each Copilot tool renders its own boundary line. Ride hailing must keep stating that it claims no partnership and requests no car.
Demo art is stroke-only SVG in components/demo/art.tsx on a 32x32 (glyph) or 64x32 (scene) grid. No bitmaps, no third-party imagery.
Execution tools are a top-level Tools tab, not a Copilot mode. Copilot holds long-term memory only.
The demo shell clamps its grid row; every surface scrolls internally. Do not reintroduce a min-height on .demo-app-shell.
Full screen is driven from EarlyAccessPage so the nav, the hero and the capability cards can all open the demo. ProductDemo does not own that state.
Every chat opens on at least two exchanges (openingShown in AskSurface).
assumptions: Operator approved hand-drawn SVG landmark line art over sourced photography, so no third-party image licence is involved.

Header button and hero button both enter full screen; body scroll locks; Escape exits and restores scroll; the frame keeps its footprint so the page does not jump.
Every chat opens on 4 or 5 messages; New Chat correctly opens on its single empty-state greeting.
No horizontal overflow inline or in full screen; the chat list becomes a horizontal strip; the nav demo button hides alongside the nav CTA as the existing design intends.

verification.command: Browser console in a clean tab
verification.summary: No errors. A table-row whitespace hydration warning was found and fixed; earlier repeated errors were a stale Turbopack buffer and did not reproduce after a server restart.
earlyaccess.go2china.space serves demo-frame, six feature cards, the nav and hero demo buttons, the chat scroll region and the full-screen control.
Guards exist but were not executed under an emulated reduced-motion setting.

risks: lib/map-geometry.ts is about 43 KB gzipped because it carries 31 simplified province outlines. Raise EPSILON in scripts/build-map.mjs if the hero payload becomes a problem.
The demo fixture layer is now large. Adding a chat means adding a CanvasDoc and a conversation together, or the Canvas falls back to an empty document.
Landmark and POI glyphs are stylised interpretations, not surveyed drawings or photographs, and must never be presented as either.
Moving the execution tools into Copilot removed Explore's Tools mode. If the operator wants both, the tool list needs a second entry point rather than a copy.
